contracts.name: MapPtrToProcess implementation
contracts.rule: After validating the supplied process handle, pointer>>25==0 and pointer>0x10000 takes the PROCESS+12 slot-OR path at RVA0x5d06..0x5d08. The kernel leaves pointers<=0x10000 unnormalized; the passive helper refuses them. Explicit pointers use a separate access-check path, which this helper does not emulate.

contracts.name: Current-process and slot0 table switch
contracts.rule: THREAD+12 selects PROCESS. The switch publishes PROCESS at0x8c145890, loads PROCESS+12, indexes TTB by slot>>23 and copies that table-root word to TTB[0]; PROCESS byte0 supplies the MMU ASID.

contracts.name: Ordinary software page translator
contracts.rule: TTB[VA>>25], second-level[(VA>>16)&511], negative ordinary MEMBLOCK+12+4*((VA>>12)&15), committed page bit0. Physical observation does not reproduce native access-key permissions.

required_separate_live_witnesses: Repeat current PROCESS, process index/slot/handle, MAPLE attachment/refcount and owner root mapping/value.
Require stable equal TTB[0] and TTB[4] root words at0x8c1458a0 and0x8c1458b0 before and after the bounded observation.
Resolve each requested explicit owner VA through repeated ordinary committed main-RAM page mappings and use the reviewed coherent data-word reader.
Never dereference the raw zero-slot pointer or infer extension type, allocated size, lifetime, ownership, native permissions or a hook lease from normalization alone.
scope: Metadata and contract hashes only. The normalizer performs scalar arithmetic and no reads, native CE calls, hardware access or guest writes.
